title: When translating OTLP histogram metrics with multiple data points, an exemplar attached to one data point leaks into ...

source.license_note: Real upstream prometheus PR #18056; ACBench task derived from its regression test + fix.

task.summary: When translating OTLP histogram metrics with multiple data points, an exemplar attached to one data point leaks into the _sum and _count series of the following data points.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the prometheusremotewrite package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: In addHistogramDataPoints the shared appOpts.Exemplars slice is not reset between data points, so exemplars from one histogram data point leak into the _sum and _count samples of subsequent data points.

ops_fault.description: OTLP histogram remote-write translation emits wrong exemplars: stale exemplars from a previous data point appear on the _sum and _count series of later data points.
detection_keywords: stale exemplar from previous data point
duplicate exemplar across histogram data points
incorrect remote-write output for OTLP histograms
localization_keywords: shared appOpts.Exemplars slice reused across data points
exemplars from previous data point not cleared
repair_keywords: reset appOpts.Exemplars to nil per data point
clear stale exemplars at start of each loop iteration
scope exemplars to a single data point

visible_context.issue_text: When an OTLP histogram has several data points, an exemplar on one data point unexpectedly shows up on the _sum and _count series of the next data points after remote-write translation.
error_logs: unexpected exemplar attached to series test_hist_sum
exemplar value 200 observed on test_hist_count for data point with no exemplars
remote-write histogram translation produced extra exemplars across data points
